rationale: The agent correctly verified identity using full name and zip code, checked the pending order, explained that exchanges require delivery, offered a modification, presented viable options, obtained explicit confirmation before modifying, and executed the change with the correct item and refund amount. However, the agent stated two pieces of information that were not supported by the tools or policy summary: (1) that no further changes or cancellations can be made to the order after modification, and (2) that the refund will be issued within 5–7 business days. The tools did not provide these constraints or timelines, and the policy requires not inventing missing facts and providing correct final information. This unsupported information violates the pass criteria.
